entries.t: Cisco Expressway Series: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
entries.sum: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

entries.t: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
entries.sum: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence said this week. The flaw allows an attacker with no account to write files outside the server's storage folder, and it affects MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in the default setup,
tl: New reporting: AI Agents Zip From Flaw Discovery to Root Access in 11 Minutes

entries.t: Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach
entries.sum: Hackers breached e-commerce platform Cleverbridge and made off with payment card data stored on it, the company has confirmed. Cleverbridge handles purchases, payments and subscriptions for other businesses, and its website lists Red Hat, Sony, SUSE, Veeam, Tenable and Jamf among its clients. The company has not said which of them, if any, had customers affected by the breach. “On 4 November 2026, Cleverbridge…

entries.t: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
entries.sum: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access the attacker used, so devices can no longer be infected through this route.

entries.t: Bromcom: 355,051 accounts in a verified breach
entries.sum: In September 2026, UK education software provider Bromcom suffered a data breach involving a legacy single sign-on (SSO) registration system . The incident exposed 355k unique email addresses belonging to staff and pupils at UK schools, alongside SSO registration reference numbers. Bromcom confirmed that no passwords or authentication tokens were exposed, and that the incident… Data: Email addresses.

entries.t: AI-Assisted Cyber Attacks Trigger Unauthorized Payments at Indian Banks and Fintech Firms
entries.sum: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has warned that threat actors are carrying out artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted cyber attacks targeting information and communication technology (ICT) assets in the country. This unsanctioned activity has resulted in unauthorized financial transactions at banking and financial services entities, as well as technology service providers

entries.t: GL.iNet Routers, KVMs Compromised via Remote Management Service Flaw
entries.sum: Attackers compromised GoodCloud, GL.iNet’s cloud remote management service, and used it to install malware on routers and KVM (keyboard, video and mouse) devices connected to it. The Chinese company, best known for its small travel routers, is still investigating, and it’s not yet known how many devices have been affected. entries.t: Behind the Alias: How One Researcher Unmasked a Decade of Ransomware Actors
entries.sum: Ransomware isn't slowing down. A new framework gives security teams the edge to trace attackers back to their source.

entries.t: FBI reportedly facing second data breach involving National Crime Information Center
entries.sum: The FBI is reportedly investigating a data breach involving the National Crime Information Center, a database used by U.S. law enforcement agencies that contains information on criminals, fugitives and missing people.

entries.t: Spanish LaLiga confirms hackers stole soccer fans’ personal data
entries.sum: LaLiga, Spain's top men's football league, disclosed a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to users of its services and those of some affiliated clubs. [...]

entries.t: Hackers breach Austrian Foreign Ministry website, access diplomats' contact details
entries.sum: Austria's Foreign Ministry said late last week that hackers breached one of its websites and accessed the names and official contact information of employees at its Vienna headquarters and at Austria’s diplomatic missions abroad.
